entities.summary: Christian Louis Ntsay is a Malagasy politician who served as the 28th Prime Minister of Madagascar from 2018 to 2025 and served as acting President in 2023. Prior to his tenure as prime minister he was Minister of Tourism from 2002 to 2003 and Madagascar's representative to the International Labour Organization from 2008 to 2018.
